name: 😈Monsters vs Guards🛡️ [🌟NEW MONSTER🌌]
desc:
⚠️The monsters have breached containment! All guards must respond ASAP and neutralize the threats⚠️

🛡️Team up with your fellow guards and take down the powerful monsters. Gather points and create new guard loadouts🛡️

😈Become a powerful monster and take out as many guards as possible, using tricks or sheer strength😈

This game is inspired by "Be an Anomaly or Guard" and "Be an SCP or Guard"

Tags: Monsters, Guards, Facility, SCP
